title: The Elevator Stopped on a Floor That Doesn't Exist #shorts #horror
description: My building has twelve floors. Last night the elevator stopped on thirteen, and someone was waiting. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

lines.text: My apartment building has twelve floors.
I came home late and pressed twelve. Twice.
The elevator went up. And kept going.
The doors opened onto a dark hallway.
Every apartment door was wide open.
At the far end, someone stood very still.
It said my name. In my own voice.
I hit close until the doors shut.
Tonight, there's a knock on my door. From the inside.
